# Psalm 13 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 13:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 13:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** How-long shall-I-set counsels in-my-soul, sorrow in-my-heart by-day? How-long shall-my-enemy be-exalted over-me?
- **LOGOS:** How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and have sorrow in my heart all day? How long will my enemy triumph over me?
- **PNEUMA:** How long must I struggle with anguish in my soul, grief in my heart every day? How long will my enemy have the upper hand?

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 13:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** But-I in-Your-steadfast-love have-trusted; my-heart rejoices in-Your-salvation. I-will-sing to-YHWH, for He-has-dealt-bountifully with-me.
- **LOGOS:** But I have trusted in Your steadfast love; my heart shall rejoice in Your salvation. I will sing to the LORD, because He has dealt bountifully with me.
- **PNEUMA:** But I trust in Your unfailing love. My heart rejoices in Your salvation. I will sing to the LORD because He is good to me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 13:4 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** Look! Answer-me, YHWH my-God! Give-light [to] my-eyes, lest I-sleep the-death,
- **LOGOS:** Consider and answer me, O LORD my God; light up my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,
- **PNEUMA:** Look at me! Answer me, LORD my God! Restore the sparkle to my eyes, or I will die.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 13:2 (overlap: 8%)

- **EMET:** How-long, YHWH? Will-You-forget-me forever? How-long will-You-hide Your-face from-me?
- **LOGOS:** How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
- **PNEUMA:** How long, LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You look the other way?

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 13:5 (overlap: 15%)

- **EMET:** lest my-enemy say, 'I-have-prevailed against-him,' [and] my-adversaries rejoice when I-am-shaken.
- **LOGOS:** lest my enemy say, 'I have prevailed over him,' and my foes rejoice because I am shaken.
- **PNEUMA:** Don't let my enemy say, 'I have defeated him.' Don't let my foes rejoice at my downfall.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
